claims.statement: The quest relationship is the first field of a quest guide, in the main area, and its description component QuestAutofill fills the form when a quest is picked.

QuestAutofill reacts only to a change of the selected quest, not the quest the guide was opened with, plans the fill of empty title, slug, SEO and summary fields, checks the slug, then fills only the planned fields still empty and adds one needs.items row per needed item when the list is still empty, marks the form modified if anything was filled, and discards results for a quest that is no longer selected.
The panel loads the linked quest from the REST API at depth 1 with the session cookie, caching one request per URL and dropping a failed request so it is retried.
slugTaken checks other quest guides with the same slug through the REST API, ignoring the guide's own ID, and answers not taken on any error so the server rejects a duplicate.

The beforeValidate hook fillFromQuest repeats the fill on save using the linked quest loaded at depth 1, falling back to the saved document for fields the update does not send and keeping the needs notes when merging the summary.
autofillFromQuest fills only blank title, slug, metaTitle and metaDescription values and fills nothing when the quest has no name.
slugFromName strips accents, lowercases, turns every run of other characters into one hyphen and trims edge hyphens, falling back to guia when nothing is left.
availableSlug returns the base slug when it is free and not reserved, and otherwise the first free slug with a -2, -3 suffix.

The SEO fill uses the Spanish templates '<name>: guía de la misión de Dofus' and a description mentioning the level and experience when present, cut at a word boundary with an ellipsis to at most 160 characters.
Summary lines end in a full stop unless they already end in punctuation, and thousands are separated by a plain space.
rewardsText lists experience, kamas and then 'N x Item' lines with the reward items in reverse DofusDB order, skipping zero amounts and unpopulated items.
prerequisitesText puts 'Nivel mínimo N' first, with N one more than a PL> value the start criterion always requires, followed by the names of the populated prerequisite quests.
neededItems keeps the quest's needed items in DofusDB order with their quantities but drops quest items with superTypeId 14 and unpopulated items, leaving monsters and map walking out.
The start NPC and coordinates come from the quest's first start position.

summaryToFill fills only empty summary fields for which DofusDB gives a value, treats 0 as a written coordinate and whitespace-only text as empty, fills the needs list only when it has no rows, and never fills the needs notes.
The generated rewards for quests 1977 and 1976 and the prerequisites for 1977 and 1433 equal the summaries the Squarespace import parsed from Torre's own pages.

summaryNote tells whether a summary field's value comes from DofusDB, was changed (showing DofusDB's value), is empty and will be filled on save, or has no DofusDB value, and reports missing, loading or failed quest data.
The needs list note compares rows with DofusDB's as a set of item and quantity pairs, so row order and populated items do not matter.
SummaryNote renders the note for its field from the live form value and the linked quest, keeping line breaks through the field-note class.

Saving a guide with only its quest stores the title, slug, SEO and a summary filled from DofusDB, with the quest item left out of the needs list and the notes empty, while written fields and non-empty needs lists are kept.
The guide text strings, including the summary formats, SEO templates and panel notes, live in one module so a second language would translate that module.
requiredLevel only reads a PL>N term that the shared criterion parser requiredTerms returns as always required, so PL>189&Qf=123 gives 190 while PL>189|Qf=123 and (PL>50|PL>60)&Qf=1 give no level.

plannedFormFill reads the current form through a field-path reader, runs autofillFromQuest and summaryToFill, and returns the non-blank values to fill by field path plus the rows for an empty needs list at summary.needs.items.

stillEmpty re-reads the form after the slug check and keeps only the planned fields that are still blank, and the needs rows only when the list still has no rows, so text Torre typed during the request is never overwritten.
In the form fill, null, undefined and whitespace-only text are blank while a number is written, and a needs value given as a row count is read as that many empty rows.

The guide's quest field is an optional single relationship to quests labelled 'Misión de DofusDB', locked once set for editors, whose panel description tells Torre to pick one quest first and that only an admin can change it later.
linkedQuestId returns the guide's quest ID whether the field holds a number or a populated document with a numeric id, and null otherwise.
The Squarespace import leaves a guide that names several DofusDB quest IDs without a linked quest and records an oddity asking Torre to pick one in the panel.
formatThousands lives in the dependency-free src/lib/guides/display.ts and format.ts re-exports it, so the guide page island can use it without importing format.ts.

The panel's preview opens /vista-previa?slug=… on the origin from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, or the request origin when it is unset, and offers no preview URL until the guide has a valid, non-reserved slug.
On save, the guide slug fill checks collisions with isRootSlugTaken across the whole root slug space and the redirect table, while the panel's live slug check only queries quest guides.
A hand-picked dungeon row must copy a dungeon note present in the guide's Notes, ignoring quantity, case and accents, and rows whose dungeon was deleted are dropped on save.
The Squarespace import keeps Torre's dungeon picks when it rewrites Notes, removing and reporting only picks whose note is gone.
